correctness.rationale: For a finite strict ordinal sum of nonempty antichains, nested diamonds ◇^k top detect exactly how many later levels are accessible; hence δ_i=◇^(h-i)⊤ ∧ ¬◇^(h-i+1)⊤ marks level i. Any r-input Boolean modal formula at a point is determined by (level i, local color c in q=2^r symbols, palette sets P_j for j>i), by structural induction on modal depth. Each such signature is definable with level/color predicates and ◇(δ_j ∧ χ_d), so every Boolean assignment to signatures yields one distinct term operation. Number of signatures E(q)=q sum_i product_{j>i} S_{n_j}(q), S_m(q)=sum_{k=1}^m C(q,k), giving 2^E. At q=1, E(1)=h. The normalized polynomial F=E/q factors F_h=1+S_{n_h}F_{h-1}, and derivative [q] S_m=1-1/2+...+(-1)^(m-1)/m separates all positive m (even partial sums increase, odd decrease). Exact recursive polynomial division recovers widths n_h through n_2, while n_1 is absent. Direct independent small q evaluations: (1,2,1) and (5,2,1) at q=2 have E=18, while (1,1,2) gives E=20; rational S-polynomial checks consistent. Finite numerical check is corroborative.
